units.source_text: 萤兵部卿亲王说过“我欲住千年”，果然住到了天亮，然后辞归。

en.t: Prince Hotaru, the Minister of War, had said, "I wish to stay for a thousand years," and indeed he stayed until dawn before taking his leave.

units.source_text: 源氏赠他的礼物，是原为自己制的常礼服一件，和未曾试过的熏香两壶，命人送到车上。

en.t: Genji's gifts to him were a set of formal everyday robes originally made for himself and two jars of incense he had not yet tried, which he had attendants carry to the carriage.
